name: io.github.millennialdreamer/cheaplane
title: Cheaplane
description: Offload grunt work from your premium agent to cheap models — auto-routing and billing isolation.

environmentVariables.name: DELEGATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving the cheap models — usually a local LiteLLM proxy.

environmentVariables.name: DELEGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for that endpoint. A local proxy ignores it; set a real one for a hosted endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: DELEGATE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-call timeout in seconds. Raise it for long documents.

environmentVariables.name: DELEGATE_MODEL_MAP
environmentVariables.description: JSON remapping the built-in aliases to your proxy's model names, e.g. {"deepseek": "deepseek-v4"}.

environmentVariables.name: DELEGATE_NO_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable the local savings ledger (metadata only, never task content).
